meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先并行读取仓库的 git 状态、最近日志和分支信息,识别该仓库惯用的提交语言与风格,再把改动按目录、关注点拆成多个原子提交;也能改写历史(rebase/squash)并用 blame、bisect、log -S 查某处改动是谁、何时加入的。
howto.when: 任何 git 操作都会用上它;当你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等词,或问某处改动是谁写的、什么时候加的、是哪个提交引入的时接管。

say.text: 把当前这些改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 它会先出提交计划再执行

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 本地提交才会改写历史

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁写的、什么时候加的
say.note: 用 blame 或 log -S 追溯

howto.what_en: Claude first runs git status, log and branch checks in parallel, detects the repo's commit language and style, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits. It also handles rebase/squash and history search via blame, bisect and log -S.
howto.when_en: Triggered for any git operation, and when you mention terms like "commit", "rebase" or "squash", or ask who wrote a change and when it was added.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into atomic commits
say_en.note: It prints a commit plan first

say_en.text: Squash my last three commits into one
Who wrote this line and when was it added?
